source.condition: Two short-stay travellers; fast access to frequently used clothing.
source.decision: Metal pipe for convenient clothing access, with other belongings in bed storage.
source.type: Own paraphrase of architect statement; not raw resident brief.

research_assumptions.initial_state: Existing ABUILD13-furniture reconstructed room, not historical original.
alternatives: Research-constructed static double wardrobe; proposed same-anchor swap only
unknowns: Which alternative the resident would prefer

fair_comparison_requirements: Both options must be placed with their usable side accessible; equal yaw is not equal functional opportunity.
Keep source-supported fast-access rationale distinct from any researcher concealment preference.
Do not label closed storage as wrong merely because this placement failed.
Count capacity, door movement and whole-room use as unknown until measured.
